subject: Final MAP acceptance, signature slot, and day-zero commitment
messages:
From: Anika Sharma <anika@stellarretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@stellarretail.com>, procurement <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v3 + SOW draft — aiming for ink by 4/30, can we lock the signature slot?

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for walking the team through the MAP yesterday. Attached is our internal alignment: we want to keep the 5/3 start date but need to lock execution approvals this week. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood confirm final exec signoff timing and preferred signer window (we have procurement at 10–12 PT on 4/29).
2) Is the SOW version you prefer the one in the attachment (SOW_StellarDraft.docx) or are you planning edits?

I've attached our version of the MAP (MAP_v3.pdf) and the draft SOW for your legal team to review. If possible, we'd like a signed agreement in DocuSign by 4/30 EOD so our onboarding cohort can start 5/3.

Thanks — looping Rajiv and procurement for availability.

Best,
Anika Sharma
VP, Digital Products | Stellar Retail
[Attachment: MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 512 KB)]
[Attachment: SOW_StellarDraft.docx (DOCX, 84 KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Sharma <anika@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + SOW draft — aiming for ink by 4/30, can we lock the signature slot?

Hi Anika — thanks, received both. Short update from our end:

- We can commit to the 5/3 onboarding target provided we get exec signoff and a countersigned SOW by 4/30 EOD.
- We're planning a 2-step approval: internal exec OK (marissa) → legal redline acceptance → procurement signature.
- Preferred signer window: we can target the 4/29 10–11 PT slot to match your procurement team's availability.

Karthik — can your team prioritize the SOW review today? I've attached a short checklist for approvals.

Action items:
- Karthik: send redlines by EOD 4/23.
- Marissa: exec decision needed by 4/28 AM so we can route DocuSign by 4/28 PM.
- Anika/Rajiv: confirm procurement signer name for the DocuSign envelope.

I'll circulate the DocuSign link once legal flags are addressed.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead — Retail
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: approval-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + SOW draft — redlines + narrow scope for signatures

Grace / team — attaching redline (SOW_redline_karthik_20270423.docx). Key points:

- Scope: clarified the production vs. eval model specs and capped initial token quotas in Table 2.
- Data handling: added explicit VPC & retention language per their ask.
- SLAs: suggested keeping indemnity/limit-of-liability language as discussed with legal counsel — left placeholders for final $$ figures.

I recommend we approach this as an "exec OK on commercial terms" + "legal confirm no high-risk clauses" flow. If Marissa can give an exec OK on 4/28 morning, I can accept the SOW for routing to DocuSign that afternoon.

DocuSign prep: I'll mark the envelope with the primary signer slots (Redwood exec; Stellar procurement) and a start-date field. Please confirm signer names.

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_redline_karthik_20270423.docx (DOCX, 96 KB)]

Subject: Exec decision request — need go/no-go by EOD to hit 5/3 onboarding (see checklist)

Marissa — quick recap and ask:

Recap:
- Karthik submitted redlines on 4/23 and flagged only the SLA/indemnity placeholders for exec confirmation.
- Stellar confirmed procurement signer (Anita Patel) and availability 4/29 10–12 PT.
- DocuSign envelope will be prepared for routing once we have an exec OK.

Ask (two short options):
- Option A (Preferred): Exec OK on commercial terms; legal to accept redlines; route DocuSign 4/28 PM; signature by Anita on 4/29; start date 5/3.
- Option B (Conservative): Delay DocuSign until 5/3, hold onboarding to 5/10 to give extra buffer for any procurement ingest delays.

Can you confirm Option A or B by 4/28 EOD? If A, I'll finalize the envelope and loop legal to stamp the SOW for routing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m call if you'd prefer to talk through the indemnity $$ placeholder.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead — Retail
Redwood Inference
